title: You Know What That Means
blurb: "And you know what that means..." is the setup line that outsources the punchline to whoever happens to be listening. Implication as a service. Play it after any statement and let context do the incriminating work on your behalf. Payday Friday? You know what that means. Parents leaving town? You know what that means. The clip itself says nothing whatsoever, so it fits everything: the listener supplies the crime, and the audio never has to take responsibility for having suggested one.
